<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  Video testimonials as thumbnails: a picture, a play button, the name and the company. The player is a port
  contract (VideoEmbed); here the button emits `play`. Axes: columns (2, 3), caption (below, overlay), tone,
  density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Quote } from "./testimonial-grid.types";

export type VideoGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  quotes: Quote[];
  playLabel: string;
  byLine: string;
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-3";
  caption?: "below" | "overlay";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  quotes,
  playLabel,
  byLine,
  cols = "1-3",
  caption = "below",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<VideoGridProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ play: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density">
    <Grid :cols="cols" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <Block v-for="q in quotes" :key="q.id" tag="figure" class="m-0 flex flex-col gap-4" data-testid="item">
        <Box class="relative">
          <MediaFrame :alt="q.author" ratio="16/9" />
          <Button
            variant="default"
            size="default"
            type="button"
            class="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 size-12 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded p-0"
            :aria-label="tpl(playLabel, q.author)"
            data-testid="play"
            @click="() => emit('play', q.id)"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="play" :size="20" />
          </Button>
          <Box
            v-if="((caption as string) === 'overlay')"
            class="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 rounded bg-background p-4"
            data-testid="caption"
          >
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ q.author }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ tpl(byLine, q.role, q.company) }}
            </Text>
          </Box>
        </Box>
        <Block v-if="((caption as string) === 'below')" tag="figcaption" data-testid="caption">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ q.author }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl(byLine, q.role, q.company) }}
          </Text>
        </Block>
      </Block>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
